sloka: तथा काशी पतिम् स्निग्धम् सततम् प्रिय वादिनम् ।सद् वृत्तम् देवसंकाशम् स्वयम् एव अनयस्व ह ॥१-१३-२३॥
transliteration: tathā kāśī patim snigdham satatam priya vādinam ।sad vṛttam devasaṁkāśam svayam eva anayasva ha ॥1-13-23॥

translations.english: Likewise bring here the aged and very righteous king of Kekaya along with his sons. He is fatherinlaw to this lion among kings (Dasaratha).
